ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an Antarctic marine food web, marked with organisms such as phytoplankton, krill, fish, penguins, leopard seal, elephant seal, and smaller toothed whales. Arrows indicate food relationships; in the figure there is an arrow from krill pointing to leopard seal, indicating that leopard seals eat krill; there is also a relationship showing that smaller toothed whales are in the predator position of leopard seals. Then reason: If smaller toothed whales eat all the leopard seals, the leopard seals disappear. In this way krill has one fewer predator, and the number eaten will decrease, so the number of krill is most likely to increase.
